title: Verify translated European clan alias selectors
changes: Verify original translated selector prefixes against the typed European clan graphics table alias.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine filter compare six original prefixes at four language values with raw interpreter complete state and clock; 48 typed alias bytes served despite poisoned ROM table.
The accepted e95 dataset, ROM and 683 frozen source hashes remain unchanged; no old publication proof was repeated.
limitations: This covers selected prefixes, not the complete decoder/transfer ABI or ordinary gameplay. Production CLI, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified; no performance measurement.
